source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. A lively, friendly market town: bustling stalls, children running, warm afternoon. Bouncy, cheerful and melodic without being childish. Tempo 126 BPM, 4/4 time, key of G major. Instrumentation: flute and clarinet melody, oboe answer, strummed acoustic guitar, marimba, walking pizzicato bass, shaker and rim clicks. Form: A melody, B melody with clarinet, back to A. Duration: 80 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
